Name: Small Lands Farm
Author: tabz906
Description:
Highly inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10129]tiny farm[/url] mod, but a little more space for buildings and such
Compatible with version 1.6.15 of Stardew Valley
Replaces the Standard farm layout, to use this mod just start a new file with the standard farm chosen
(WARNING: may break old files if you install this mid game, i recommend you start a new file if you want to play with this farm layout)﻿
Has location indicators as a template to put buildings, however not required although the starter fence is permanent
Should be compatible with most other mods that do not replace the standard farm layout or modify the standard farm map itself

Special thanks to the Stardew Valley Discord server for helping me with this mod 

To install: just download the file and unzip it into the /Mods folder like usual, requires the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher to run

notice: i wont be changing the map for UI requests however feel free to edit it yourself and make your own modifications
